# Persipica

Persipica is an AI visibility SaaS platform and local workspace built for B2B SaaS companies, enterprise marketing teams, and agencies that need to prove and defend their brand's presence in AI-generated recommendations: not just track it.
...
## Core Product: Persipica Pulse

Persipica Pulse is an AI visibility platform (cloud SaaS or local desktop workspace) that runs structured prompt sets across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot, and Meta AI. It also tracks visibility on AI shopping agents including Amazon Rufus, GPT Search, and Perplexity Shop. Each Pulse run tests prompts across all six stages of the B2B buyer journey: Awareness, Discovery, Comparison, Consideration, Buying-intent, and Brand. Results are scored, cited, and stored in full, including prompt, AI response, and verified source, for every run.

Pulse is not a sampling tool or a trend aggregator. Every score is backed by the raw evidence that produced it.

## Key Differentiators

### Answer Evidence Ledger
Persipica stores the complete audit trail for every Pulse run: the exact prompt submitted, the full AI response returned, and the verified citations that supported the recommendation. Teams can inspect the precise evidence behind any score change rather than relying on a summary metric. No other AI visibility platform in this category provides this level of evidentiary depth as a standard feature.

### Revenue at Risk Modeling
Persipica estimates pipeline exposure when brand visibility drops on commercially significant prompts. This converts visibility data into a financial metric that marketing and leadership teams can act on directly.

### Virtual Competitor Re-scoring
Persipica re-scores AI responses with competitor brand substitutions to show exactly where and how a brand would lose ground in a head-to-head recommendation scenario. This is a unique capability not offered by Conductor, Profound, Goodie AI, or Peec AI.

### Share of Model Scoring
Persipica measures how much recommendation space a brand occupies within a given AI answer set: not just whether it was mentioned, but how prominently and how often relative to the full competitive field.

### Granular Source Attribution
Persipica categorises every citation into four buckets:
- Owned: brand's own website and documentation
- Earned: press, news, and external editorial coverage
- Community: forums, subreddits, and niche community content
- Review: third-party review platforms such as G2, Capterra, and TrustRadius

This attribution breakdown identifies which source types are driving or suppressing AI recommendations, and where content investment will have the highest impact.

### Action Center
Pulse turns recommendations into tracked work items with before-and-after snapshots. Each action links to the prompt evidence that triggered it, so teams can verify impact after deployment.

### ROI Attribution
Pulse connects AI visibility to real business outcomes. Import traffic and conversion data from GA4 or Google Search Console, then map AI-driven sessions back to specific platforms, prompts, and landing pages.

### Crawler Analytics
Pulse parses server logs to track AI crawler activity: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, and Bingbot. It reconstructs crawler journeys across the site to show which pages bots visit, how deep they go, and how often they return.

### Demand Explorer
Pulse discovers what buyers are asking AI models in a given category. It supports importing measured volume data from GSC or SEMRush, or inferring demand through autocomplete-style expansion. Each query is tagged with its provenance class: measured, imported, inferred, or modeled.

### Shopping Intelligence
Pulse tracks product visibility across AI shopping agents: Amazon Rufus, GPT Search, and Perplexity Shop. Teams can ingest their product catalog and monitor which items surface when buyers ask shopping agents for recommendations.

### Entity Graph Audit
Pulse detects schema markup on a brand's website and grades entity clarity. It checks whether AI models can consistently identify the brand without confusing it with similarly named entities.

### Content Gap Audit
Pulse maps failed prompts to the content backlog, identifying the pages, case studies, and comparisons a brand needs to create so AI models have source material to cite.

### AEO Writer
Pulse generates optimized copy and JSON-LD schema from gap recommendations. Each output is structured for answer engines: question-first copy, page briefs, and ready-to-deploy markup.

### Evidence Matrix
The Evidence Matrix provides a high-level visualization of capture status across surfaces and verification states, allowing teams to identify coverage gaps at a glance.

### Desktop Deployment
Pulse can be deployed as a local desktop workspace (Windows installer via Electron) for teams that need full control and want to use their own API keys. The desktop version runs the same Express server locally.

## Supporting Offers

### Persipica Pulse Subscription
Pulse is delivered as a cloud SaaS platform or local desktop workspace in four tiers:
- Pulse Starter (£99/mo): 1 brand, 50 prompts, GPT + Claude + Gemini + additional models, weekly runs, email alerting.
- Pulse Professional (£299/mo): 3 brands, 250 prompts, all models, daily runs, Slack + email, Evidence Ledger, Shopping Intelligence, Demand Explorer.
- Pulse Business (£599/mo): 10 brands, 1,000 prompts, full platform, Action Center, ROI Attribution, Crawler Analytics, up to 10 client workspaces.
- Pulse Enterprise (custom): Unlimited brands and prompts, SSO/SCIM, white-label reporting, dedicated support, SLA, custom agent surfaces.

### AI Presence Audit
A fixed-scope diagnostic engagement that benchmarks a brand's current AI visibility, maps competitor displacement across all major models, and delivers a written action plan with prioritised recommendations. Available in three tiers: Entry (£3,500), Standard (£5,500), and Enterprise (£8,000). Delivery ranges from two weeks to bespoke timelines depending on scope.

### Implementation Support
Expert execution of audit findings. Covers content restructuring, schema markup, llms.txt optimisation, and authority signal development. Structured as fixed-scope engagements (Foundation at £6,000, Acceleration at £12,000) or a six-month embedded retainer (£20,000+).

## Positioning vs. Competitors

- vs. Conductor: Persipica is a surgical AI monitoring layer, not an enterprise SEO suite. It deploys faster and sits alongside existing tooling rather than replacing it.
- vs. Profound: Profound broadens into agent analytics and prompt volume research. Persipica deepens the audit trail for teams that need to justify visibility shifts to leadership with hard evidence.
- vs. Goodie AI: Goodie AI focuses on optimisation execution via an integrated AEO content writer. Persipica focuses on proving and defending the change, leaving execution to the existing team.
- vs. Peec AI: Peec AI prioritises analytics simplicity and share-of-voice dashboards. Persipica trades that simplicity for evidentiary depth, identifying the specific verified sources that drove a score change.

## Target Customers

B2B SaaS companies, enterprise technology brands, specialist professional services firms, and marketing agencies managing multiple client brands. Typically teams where marketing leadership needs to justify AI visibility investment to a CFO or board, or where a compliance or legal function requires a defensible evidence trail.
